shots.note: L1 villain whisper 'Quick, she's asleep.' plays over ANANYA sleeping in moonlight with the exact closed jar on the bedside. Use the moonlit first 3.6 s, before the dawn warm-up. The woman is replaced, so her S3 is replaced too.

shots.note: Label is correct (2% KOJIC ACID visible) and the cute night team matches L2 'So is my night team' and L3 'Keep it down. We're working.' The sleeper behind is heavily defocused. If continuity QA still flags her, swap in KNA2_avatar_ingredients.

shots.content: Long sequence on the fair woman's sleeping cheek: Kojic, Niacinamide and Alpha Arbutin characters fight dot-like spots (baked captions). Then a finger dabs thick unblended cream on the spotty cheek, then a sunlit morning shot still has the cream blob on her cheek under a garbled 'After 2 Weeks / Taa hps even skin tone'.
shots.note: There is no VO from 6.93 to 11.4: three orbs rise from the open jar (4.47 s of KNA2), each with its own pill (gold = 2% KOJIC ACID, icy = NIACINAMIDE, pink = ALPHA ARBUTIN). L4 narrator 'Working through the night for brighter, even-looking skin' then runs over ANANYA waking in daylight with spotless glowing skin (morning super) and the B/A split (KN08 | KN07, AFTER 2 WEEKS).

shots.content: Packshot: exact jar mascot asleep on the bedside with the three sleeping ingredient characters; baked 'DERMDOC 2% Kojic Acid Night Cream' and 'Target Dark Spots While You Sleep'.
shots.note: Jar and label are correct and the baked text is spelled right. Matches L5 'Dark spots don't get the night off.'
